# HR Niti — HRMS & Payroll Software for India

> HR Niti is an India-focused cloud-based Human Resource Management System (HRMS) and payroll software platform. It centralizes employee lifecycle records, 1-click automated multi-state payroll, attendance tracking (mobile GPS geofencing & biometrics), leave policy management, statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, MLWF, Form 16, Form 24Q), recruitment, performance OKRs, and employee self-service.

## Primary Product Modules

- [HRMS Software](https://www.hrniti.com/hrms-software): Centralized employee database, org chart, lifecycle workflows, and document management.
- [Payroll Software](https://www.hrniti.com/payroll-software): Automated Indian payroll engine with PF, ESIC, Professional Tax (PT), MLWF, TDS tax computations, and direct bank transfer payouts.
- [Attendance Management System](https://www.hrniti.com/attendance): Mobile GPS geofencing, selfie attendance verification, shift scheduling, and real-time biometric hardware integrations.
- [Leave Management System](https://www.hrniti.com/leave-management): Configurable leave policies (Casual, Earned, Sick, Maternity), automated accruals, and manager approval workflows.
- [Full & Final Exit Settlement](https://www.hrniti.com/full-and-final-settlement): Automated exit payouts, unavailed leave encashment, notice period recovery, and gratuity calculations.
- [Recruitment & ATS](https://www.hrniti.com/recruitment-management): Applicant tracking system, interview panel feedback, and automated offer letter workflows.
- [Performance Management](https://www.hrniti.com/employee-performance-management-software): KPI/OKR goal tracking, continuous feedback cycles, and performance appraisals.
- [HR MIS & Analytics](https://www.hrniti.com/hr-mis-reports): Real-time workforce analytics, turnover metrics, and operational HR reporting.
- [GenAI HR Assistant](https://www.hrniti.com/hr-chatbot): AI-powered conversational chatbot for employee self-service, leave requests, policy queries, and payslip summaries.

## Business Solutions by Scale

- [Small Business HRMS (1-50 Employees)](https://www.hrniti.com/small-business-solutions): HRMS and payroll tailored for startups and small businesses.
- [Medium Business HRMS (50-250 Employees)](https://www.hrniti.com/medium-business-solutions): HRMS and workforce management for growing mid-sized organizations.
- [Large Enterprise HRMS (250+ Employees)](https://www.hrniti.com/large-business-solutions): Multi-location enterprise HRMS with advanced security and custom integrations.

## Free HR Calculators & Tools

- [Free HR Tools & Calculators Hub](https://www.hrniti.com/tools): Collection of online calculators for HR professionals, payroll managers, and employees.
- [Free Payslip Generator](https://www.hrniti.com/tools/payslip-generator): Create and download professional employee salary slips in PDF format.
- [Employee ID Card Maker](https://www.hrniti.com/tools/id-card-designer): Design and download print-ready CR80 standard employee ID card badges in PDF format.
- [Gratuity Calculator](https://www.hrniti.com/tools/gratuity-calculator): Calculate estimated gratuity payouts under the Code on Social Security 2020 rules.
- [Leave Encashment Calculator](https://www.hrniti.com/tools/leave-encashment-calculator): Calculate unused earned leave cash-out payouts and tax exemptions.
- [Salary Hike Calculator](https://www.hrniti.com/tools/salary-hike-calculator): Calculate increment percentage, revised salary, and annual CTC increase.
- [In-Hand Salary Calculator](https://www.hrniti.com/tools/in-hand-salary-calculator): Estimate monthly net take-home salary from annual CTC in India.
- [CTC Calculator](https://www.hrniti.com/tools/ctc-calculator): Calculate Cost to Company salary component breakups.
- [EPF Calculator](https://www.hrniti.com/tools/pf-calculator): Calculate monthly employee/employer Provident Fund contributions and maturity corpus.
- [Full & Final Settlement Calculator](https://www.hrniti.com/tools/final-settlement-calculator): Calculate exit settlement payouts including unpaid salary, leave, and gratuity.
